image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a single white daisy flower with a bright yellow center. The flower is in sharp focus against a blurred green background (bokeh). A small green insect is visible on the left side of the yellow disc.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Petals are elongated and radiate correctly from the center; count appears consistent with species norms.

To detect subtle edge bleeding, melting, or texture inconsistencies in the white petals against the green background.
To ensure the flower head is a single connected component without floating petal fragments or disconnected centers.
